_comment: MiniMax Music3 text+lyrics -> song. ComfyUI API format (the shape POST /prompt accepts),
so this file is both the UI starting point and the thing automation submits.
Seeded to user/default/workflows/ordo/ by scripts/comfyui/boot.sh — repo-owned, replaced
on every boot. Edit it here, not in the UI.
Requires ComfyUI >= v0.33.1 (services/comfyui pins COMFYUI_APP_REF) and the
Submit THROUGH the gate (http://comfyui-gate:8188/prompt), never straight to comfyui:8188 —
the gate acquires GPU residency before the render starts. See services/gpu-gate/README.md.

inputs.caption:
Global Metadata: Warm indie-folk, 96 BPM, G major, bright and unhurried. Sunday-morning mood, clean modern production with a little room ambience.

Vocal Details: Single relaxed female lead, close-mic'd and conversational, light double-tracking on the chorus, soft harmonies underneath.

Arrangement: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar as the spine, brushed kit entering on the first verse, round upright bass, occasional piano answers. Intro: guitar alone. Verses: guitar, bass, brushes. Chorus: full band, harmonies open up. Outro: back to solo guitar, one last held chord.
inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Morning light across the kitchen floor
Kettle humming like it has before
Nothing urgent waiting at the door
Just the day and nothing more

[Chorus]
So let it be slow
Let the hours go
Nothing left to prove
Nothing left to move

[Verse]
Coffee cooling while the record turns
Same four chords, and still I never learn
Every season takes its turn
And the quiet ones return

[Chorus]
So let it be slow
Let the hours go
Nothing left to prove
Nothing left to move

[Outro]

6._note: seconds is driven by the encoder's second output — the model can end the song early, and the latent must match the length it actually chose.
